is_anopheles.evidence: Study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. gambiae, An. coluzzii, An. arabiensis) collected in northern Benin (page 1, page 11).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Screened kdr L1014F (Vgsc L995F), kdr L1014S (Vgsc L995S), N1575Y (Vgsc N1570Y), and ace-1 G119S (Ace-1 G280S) using TaqMan PCR (page 5, Table 3).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 3 on page 11 provides genotype counts (RR, RS, SS), sample sizes (N=60 per group), and allele frequencies f(R) for alive and dead mosquitoes at each study site.

african_field_population.evidence: Anopheles gambiae s.l. larvae were collected from breeding sites in vegetable farms in Malanville and Parakou, Benin, between October and November 2023 (page 4).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research article reporting original field survey, bioassay, and molecular genotyping data.

sub_country_location.evidence: Data are collected from specific communes with coordinates provided: Malanville (11°50'38'' to 11°52'02'' N, 3°22'00'' to 3°24'02'' E) and Parakou (9°20'13'' N, 2°37'49'' E), Benin (page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquito larvae were collected between October and November 2023 (page 4).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Original field sampling carried out in October-November 2023 for this study.

supplement.evidence: All primary bioassay results and genotype data are completely presented in the main text and Table 3.

assessment.summary: Primary study assessing insecticide resistance profiles and molecular marker frequencies (Vgsc L995F, Vgsc L995S, Vgsc N1570Y, Ace-1 G280S) in field populations of Anopheles gambiae s.l. from vegetable farms in Malanville and Parakou, Benin, collected in late 2023. Genotype counts are provided separately for alive and dead mosquitoes post-exposure.
